parameters.help_zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所申请的最少内存。例如`1Mi`表示1 MB
parameters.name: tracing_on_ext_zipkin_request_memory

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of CPU cores that are allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core
parameters.help_zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所限制的最大CPU核数。例如`1000m`表示1核CPU
parameters.name: tracing_on_ext_zipkin_limit_cpu

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory that is allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1Mi` indicates 1 MB
parameters.help_zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所限制的最大内存。例如`1Mi`表示1 MB
parameters.name: tracing_on_ext_zipkin_limit_memory

parameters.help_en: The number of replicas for the proxy service that exports Tracing Analysis data
parameters.help_zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务的副本数量
parameters.name: tracing_on_ext_zipkin_replica_count

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the access logs of the ingress gateway that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 采集到SLS的入口网关访问日志的存储周期（天）。例如`30`代表30天
parameters.name: access_log_gateway_lifecycle

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the access logs of the sidecar proxy that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 采集到SLS的Sidecar访问日志的存储周期（天）。例如`30`代表30天
parameters.name: access_log_sidecar_lifecycle

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic diagnostics for the service mesh. If you enable this feature, the service mesh is automatically diagnosed when you modify an Istio resource in the service mesh
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用网格自动诊断功能（开启后，当修改网格内Istio资源时，将会自动对网格进行诊断）
parameters.name: enable_auto_diagnosis

parameters.help_en: The outbound ports for which traffic is redirected to the sidecar proxy
parameters.help_zh: 设置端口使outbound流量经过Sidecar
parameters.name: include_outbound_ports

parameters.help_en: The log level of the sidecar proxy on the data plane. The log levels are sorted in ascending order of the log verbosity: `none`, `error`, `warn`, `info`, and `debug`
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据面Sidecar代理的日志级别。日志级别按输出日志信息量从低到高排序依次为`none`、`error`、`warn`、`info`、`debug`
parameters.name: log_level

parameters.help_en: The degree of parallelism for the sidecar proxy on the data plane
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据面Sidecar代理的并行度
parameters.name: concurrency

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to wait for the sidecar proxy container to start before the application container starts when a pod is being started
parameters.help_zh: 设置在Pod启动时是否先等待Sidecar代理容器启动再启动业务容器
parameters.name: hold_application_until_proxy_starts

parameters.help_en: The additional metrics that are reported by the sidecar proxy on the data plane
parameters.help_zh: 设定数据面Sidecar代理额外上报的指标
parameters.name: proxy_stats_matcher

parameters.help_en:
The mode of inbound traffic interception by the sidecar proxy. Valid values:

`REDIRECT`: the default interception mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using redirection.

`TPROXY`: the transparent proxy mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using a transparent proxy
parameters.help_zh:
Sidecar对入向流量的拦截策略。取值：
`REDIRECT`：默认的拦截策略，Sidecar将使用重定向方式拦截入向流量。
`TPROXY`：透明代理拦截策略，Sidecar将以透明代理的方式拦截入向流量
parameters.name: interception_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to load the bootstrap configurations before the sidecar proxy starts
parameters.help_zh: 设定是否令Sidecar代理在启动前加载bootstrap配置
parameters.name: enable_bootstrap_xds_agent

parameters.help_en:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and use ARMS Prometheus to collect metrics, and the ARMS Prometheus instance has a token-based authentication configuration, you can use this parameter to specify the authentication token. This authorizes the mesh topology to access the ARMS Prometheus instance.
The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the authentication token of the ARMS Prometheus instance that is installed in the data plane cluster
parameters.help_zh:
当启用网格拓扑功能且集成ARMS Prometheus采集监控指标时，若ARMS Prometheus实例配置了鉴权token，通过此参数设定ARMS Prometheus的鉴权Token，以授权网格拓扑访问ARMS Prometheus实例。
参数格式为JSON编码的字符串，JSON对象中的键为数据面集群的集群ID，值为数据面集群内安装的ARMS Prometheus实例设定的鉴权Token
parameters.name: kiali_arms_auth_tokens

parameters.help_en:
The default scheduling configurations that ASM delivers to the data plane components. You can configure `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` in the JSON format.

Modifying this parameter is a high-risk operation. This operation restarts all data plane components in the ASM instance. Proceed with caution.

These configurations do not apply to ASM gateways. To configure scheduling for an ASM gateway, specify the scheduling configurations in the gateway settings
parameters.help_zh:
ASM下发到数据面组件的默认调度配置。支持以JSON的形式配置`nodeSelector`和`tolerations`。

该参数的修改属于高危操作。该操作会导致ASM所有的数据面组件重启，请谨慎操作。
此处配置不包括ASM网关，网关调度请在网关中配置
parameters.name: default_components_schedule_config

parameters.help_en:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and create a CLB instance to access the mesh topology, you can use this parameter to configure the CLB instance for the mesh topology service in different clusters using annotations.

The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the annotation of the mesh topology service in the data plane cluster.

For more information about how to configure a CLB instance using annotations, see <props="intl">Use annotations to configure a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/container-service-for-kubernetes/latest/use-annotations-to-configure-load-balancing-1)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
当开启网格拓扑且为访问网格拓扑创建CLB时，通过此参数使用Annotation配置不同集群中网格拓扑服务的CLB。

参数格式为JSON编码的字符串，JSON对象中的键为数据面集群的集群ID，值为数据面集群中网格拓扑服务的Annotation内容。

有关如何通过注解配置CLB，请参考<props="china"> 通过Annotation配置传统型负载均衡CLB (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86531.html)</props><props="intl">通过Annotation配置传统型负载均衡CLB (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/container-service-for-kubernetes/latest/use-annotations-to-configure-load-balancing-1)</props>
parameters.name: kiali_service_annotations

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the ASM gateway to Simple Log Service
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用将ASM网关访问日志采集到阿里云日志服务SLS
parameters.name: access_log_gateway_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the sidecar proxy to Simple Log Service
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用将ASM网格代理（Sidecar）的日志采集到阿里云日志服务SLS
parameters.name: access_log_sidecar_enabled

parameters.help_en: The labels of the workloads that are offloaded
parameters.help_zh: 隔离工作负载的标签
parameters.name: labels_for_offloaded_workloads

parameters.help_en: The new root certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh
parameters.help_zh: 新的RootCert。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数
parameters.name: existing_root_ca_cert

parameters.help_en: The new CA certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh
parameters.help_zh: 新的CaCert。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数
parameters.name: existing_ca_cert

parameters.help_en: The new CA key. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh
parameters.help_zh: 新的CaKey。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数
parameters.name: existing_ca_key

parameters.help_en: The certificate chain from the CA certificate to the root certificate. The certificate chain must contain at least two certificates
parameters.help_zh: 从CaCert到RootCert的证书链，至少包含两个证书

parameters.help_zh: 是否安装 SMC 加速
parameters.name: smc_enabled
